summary: A four-track FM groovebox with a tracker-style sequencer in place of a step grid, and a first-person dungeon crawl on the home screen that is played out by the song. A fork of Felucca 1.6.1.
features: Eight engines: YM2612-style FM, wavetables, Amiga-style samples, SID, analog
Tracker screen per track, with an effects command column
Track "classes" share a 12-voice budget, so tracks never steal voices
DICE sound design: roll random but musical sound parameters
RANDOM SONG builds a four-section song; 11 song slots plus autosave
MIDI channels 1-4 play the tracks; clock in over TRS
